narration: The framework takes multimodal inputs: a reconstructed 3D point cloud along with RGB images, depth maps, and camera poses.
In Step 1, a 3D superpoint is selected and projected across views to build a visibility histogram, identifying the optimal pivot view.
The projected superpoint prompts SAM 2 to segment the object in the pivot view, creating an initial high-quality 2D mask.
Guided by 3D geometric cues, SAM 2 tracks the mask bidirectionally across forward and backward passes, producing a continuous 2D mask track.
In Step 2, the 2D mask track is lifted into a 3D candidate mask, then refined through continuous optimization to clean boundary artifacts.
The optimization yields a clean final 3D proposal for each object, building a comprehensive class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation.
Finally, the 3D proposals are classified using CLIP and large language models to produce open-vocabulary and open-ended 3D instance segmentations.
